atoms.title: The Violin
atoms.b: The violin, also called the fiddle, is a small bowed instrument with four strings. You lay it on your shoulder and can play either sitting or standing.
atoms.sound: The violin, also called the fiddle, is a small beau'd instrument with four strings. You lay it on your shoulder, and can play either sitting or standing.

atoms.title: The Viola
atoms.b: The viola looks very similar to a violin at first glance. The viola is quite a bit larger than a violin though and can play lower notes. You can also play a viola while standing or sitting.
atoms.sound: The viola looks very similar to a violin at first glance. The viola is quite a bit larger than a violin though and can play lower notes. You can also play a viola while standing or sitting.

atoms.title: The Cello
atoms.b: The cello is a bowed instrument that also has four strings. You prop the cello up on the floor and play it while sitting.
atoms.sound: The cello, short for veealuhn cello, is a beaued instrument that also has four strings. You prop the cello up on the floor and play it while sitting.

atoms.title: The Double Bass
atoms.b: The double bass is one of the largest string instruments and plays very low tones. Since it is so large, you need to play either while standing, or while sitting on a very tall chair.
atoms.sound: The double bass is one of the largest string instruments and plays very low tones. Since it is so large, you need to play either while standing, or while sitting on a very tall chair.
The double bassist plays the double bass.
